properties.name: Wasdale Head approach
properties.reason: Very narrow and tortuous in places, single-track sections and a narrow bridge. National Trust accepts campervans/motorhomes only under 6.5 m on this access; a Transporter-sized camper is below that threshold but care is warranted.

properties.name: Low Wray campsite approach
properties.reason: National Trust states the road leading to Low Wray is narrow in places and larger motorhomes should take care. Useful warning for an otherwise innocuous-looking local road.

properties.name: Highertown Farm / Lansallos approach
properties.reason: Narrow single-track lanes with passing places. National Trust limits campervans/motorhomes to 6 m because of the approach; a Transporter LWB fits but this is exactly the sort of sat-nav lane worth flagging.

properties.name: Abbott Street to Kingston Lacy motorhome site
properties.reason: Abbott Street narrows to a single-track country lane with intermittent passing areas before the motorhome-site entrance. Suitable but unexpectedly constrained.

properties.name: White Cliffs of Dover level 4 parking access
properties.reason: National Trust explicitly tells motorhomes and campervans not to use this access because a tight bend and abrupt level change can ground the vehicle.

properties.name: Peasholm Drive constrained section
properties.reason: Council consultation evidence repeatedly describes this residential road as narrow with parked cars reducing usable width and larger motorhomes causing obstruction. Flagged as a local congestion/access caution rather than a hard restriction.
